featured_reviews.name: raju mange
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhanushali Banquets is easily one of the best venues in Mumbai. They have multiple banquet halls catering to all types of functions – marriage, sangeet, birthday, conferences, mata ki chowki, or any religious event.

They can host anywhere from 300 to 1000 guests across multiple floors, and the grand lobby makes for a great first impression. The staff is very courteous, and the entire place is kept spotlessly clean.

Infrastructure is top-notch: multiple elevators, escalators, dedicated freight elevators, and separate elevators for staff so guest movement is never disrupted. Ample basement parking and genset backup ensure zero hassle.

Their USP has to be the centralised AC – even during peak hours with a packed house, the cooling stays consistent. Acoustics are also very well done; no echo or sound reflection, so music and speeches sound clear and balanced.

If you want a premium, well-managed venue with great facilities, Bhanushali Banquets should be your first choice in Mumbai for any event.

The Kanara Catholic Association (KCA) in Bandra, Mumbai, is a community-centric organization that promotes the culture, traditions, and welfare of the Kanara Catholic community. If you're referring to an experience at a KCA event or a visit to the KCA Bandra Hall, here's what to expect:

1. Events and Gatherings

The KCA regularly organizes a variety of cultural, social, and religious events for the community:

Traditional Celebrations: Events like Monti Fest (Nativity Feast) are celebrated with great enthusiasm, featuring traditional Mangalorean food, music, and rituals.

Cultural Programs: Konkani music nights, drama performances, and traditional dance events bring the community together.

Charity and Welfare Activities: The association supports educational and social causes, with events aimed at fundraising or providing aid to those in need.

2. The KCA Hall (Bandra)

The KCA Hall is a popular venue located in the heart of Bandra. It is often used for:

Community Gatherings: Meetings, weddings, or small family celebrations.

Religious Services: Occasionally used for prayer meetings or novenas.

Workshops and Seminars: Skill development or career-oriented events for the youth.
The hall is well-maintained, though its ambiance is simple and functional, making it a convenient choice for mid-sized gatherings.

3. Food and Hospitality

Traditional Mangalorean cuisine is often a highlight of events hosted by the KCA. Dishes like sannas, pork sorpotel, and Mangalore buns are commonly served.

The hospitality at KCA events is warm and welcoming, reflecting the community's values.

4. Community Spirit

Attending a KCA event is a wonderful way to experience the vibrant and close-knit Kanara Catholic culture. Expect:

A strong sense of camaraderie and shared tradition.

Engaging conversations and networking opportunities within the community.

featured_reviews.name: Edwin D'cruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic experience at Josephs Dreamland Park. The only “dreamland” part of this venue is dreaming that basic facilities, hygiene, or decent service might actually exist.

Providing something as simple as a fan was apparently considered a luxury. Guests were expected to sit there sweating and suffering while management behaved as if comfort was some premium add-on. When asked about fans during the wedding, they shamelessly demanded ₹750 per fan. Imagine charging ₹10 lakhs for a venue and still trying to squeeze extra money for the most basic necessity.

When questioned whether this was clearly informed to the bride and groom beforehand, their response was the peak of arrogance and stupidity: “You never asked.” What kind of incompetent management thinks people booking a wedding venue need to specifically ask whether guests will have fans? How does it even cross anyone’s mind that fans would not be available unless specially requested?

The insect situation was equally disgusting. Bugs were continuously dropping onto tables and chairs, giving guests an unforgettable experience in filth and neglect. Hygiene standards here are clearly nonexistent. The real starters of the evening were not fish fingers or chicken fry, but bugs and crickets falling fresh from above. If serving pests was part of the menu, then this venue truly exceeded expectations.

And water for guests? Apparently another luxury item. Not even providing drinking water shows just how cheap, careless, and disgraceful the service truly is.

To make it worse, the host Mr Alex was disgusting — rude, unapologetic, and completely lacking even basic manners or professionalism. They behaved as if doing the guests a favor while delivering third-rate service.

Overall, this place is a complete embarrassment. Greedy management, filthy conditions, zero hospitality, and standards so low they are almost insulting. Charging lakhs while failing at the basics is nothing short of a scam. Avoid this venue at all costs unless you want your special occasion ruined by incompetence and greed.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Atarah Banquet: A name you can trust for all your celebrations.
We recently hosted our son’s first birthday here, and we cannot stop praising this venue. Below is our honest and detailed review:

From my very first enquiry call, I was introduced to Ms. Mamta Jain, the main coordinator for our event. Mamta is someone you can share ideas with, and she will make them happen. Kudos to her for being patient and supportive through every call, message, and in-person meeting.

We opted for the Gold package (veg and non-veg), which included:

• 2 welcome drinks
• 2–3 starters
• 3 main course dishes
• 2 types of rice
• 1 dal dish
• 3 varieties of Indian breads
• 3 desserts
• 1 ice cream

We also added a Pan counter at a nominal cost. The best part of Atarah’s packages is the flexibility—you can customize everything to your preferences. For example, although the package included a Chinese dish, we replaced it with a Chaat counter (3 dishes), which turned out to be a fantastic choice.

Our menu selections:

• Welcome drinks: Watermelon cooler (mojito) and Guava chilli
• Starters (10/10):• Veg: Cheese corn balls, Veg spring rolls (not on the menu, but Atarah graciously obliged)
• Non-veg: Chicken chilli, Chicken tikka

• Main course (10/10):• Rice: Jeera rice, Dum biryani (veg & non-veg)
• Dal fry
• Veg: Tawa bhaji, Paneer lababdar, Dum aloo
• Non-veg: Chicken kadai, Chicken Afghani, Mutton sukha

• Indian breads (10/10): Puri, Butter roti, Garlic naan
• Desserts (10/10): Aamras, Angoor basundi, Rabdi jalebi• Special mention: The Aamras was the highlight—every guest went back for seconds!

• Ice cream (9/10): Kulfi slice
• Chaat (10/10): Pani puri, Katori chaat, Ragda patties
• Pan counter (10/10)

The package also included papad, pickle, mukhwas, and mineral water (200 ml).

We added activities like caricature and face painting. While the services were enjoyable, one regret was that the caricature artists left after two hours despite being booked for 200 guests. Unfortunately, even we—the hosts—didn’t get our portraits done.

Aside from this minor hiccup, everything else was flawless. From decorations (lights, stage, hall, seating) to music, food, and service, Atarah delivered perfection. Both Ms. Mamta and Mr. Jayesh coordinated with us until the very end, ensuring the event ran smoothly.

Final verdict:
Atarah Banquets exceeded our expectations and made our son’s first birthday truly memorable. We wholeheartedly recommend them to friends and family.
